svg.title: Co-WingMan detailed edge AI architecture
svg.desc: Detailed grouped system architecture for Co-WingMan showing user control, the Jetson speech pipeline, bounded context, UF NaviGator hosted inference, local validation and output, optional portfolio and S3 continuity, and operational safeguards.
svg.text: Co-WingMan EDGE AI · Detailed System Architecture
Local NVIDIA speech processing + bounded context + UF NaviGator Nemotron + validated short cues
Commands, triggers, bounded state, request lifecycle, and sanitized status remain under operator control.
no audio API input · no transcript log
A · LOCAL SPEECH & CONTEXT · NVIDIA JETSON
Raw audio and speech models remain on the device.
selected only when a cue is requested
Only bounded selected text crosses the Jetson–UF trust boundary.
local JSON or optional S3 load
JSON shape · types · safety · no echo
Validated output returns locally; persistence remains separately opt-in.
never triggers cues or infers anxiety
Primary privacy boundary: raw microphone audio stays on the Jetson; only bounded selected text is sent to UF NaviGator over HTTPS.
